use default

let small = [
    "zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven",
    "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen",
    "fifteen", "sixteen", "seventeen", "eighteen", "nineteen"
]

let tens = [
    "twenty", "thirty", "forty", "fifty",
    "sixty", "seventy", "eighty", "ninety"
]

let scales = [
    "thousand", "million", "billion",
    "trillion", "quadrillion", "quintillion"
]

below_hundred(value: int) -> string =>
    if value < 20 then
        small[value]
    elif value % 10 == 0 then
        tens[value / 10 - 2]
    else
        "{tens[value / 10 - 2]}-{small[value % 10]}"
    fi

below_thousand(value: int) -> string =>
    if value < 100 then
        below_hundred(value)
    elif value % 100 == 0 then
        "{small[value / 100]} hundred"
    else
        "{small[value / 100]} hundred and {below_hundred(value % 100)}"
    fi

groups(value: long) -> LIST[int] is
    let parts = LIST[int]()
    let rest mut = value

    while rest > 0L do
        parts.add(cast int(rest % 1000L))

        rest = rest / 1000L
    od

    return parts
si

cardinal(value: long) -> string is
    if value < 0L then
        return "negative {cardinal(-value)}"
    elif value == 0L then
        return small[0]
    fi

    let parts = groups(value)
    let named = LIST()

    let at mut = parts.count - 1

    while at >= 0 do
        if parts[at] != 0 then
            let name = below_thousand(parts[at])

            named.add(if at == 0 then name else "{name} {scales[at - 1]}" fi)
        fi

        at = at - 1
    od

    if named.count > 1 /\ parts[0] != 0 /\ parts[0] < 100 then
        let last = named[named.count - 1]
        let leading = named |> take(named.count - 1) |> join(" ")

        return "{leading} and {last}"
    fi

    return named |> join(" ")
si

let samples = [
    0L, 1L, 12L, 20L, 21L, 99L, 100L, 101L, 120L, 123L, 999L,
    1000L, 1001L, 1010L, 1100L, 12345L, 100000L, 1000000L,
    1000001L, 123456789L, -1234L, 9223372036854775807L
]

for sample in samples do
    write_line("{sample,22}  {cardinal(sample)}")
od
